edges.trigger_rule: dh_obs.max_ratio >= 0.50 OR dh_combined.max_ratio >= 0.75 OR bipad_rain_flood_alerts > 0 coinciding with elevated GloFAS basin, DHM river warning, or dh_obs.max_ratio >= 1.00
edges.uncertainty_note: Dahal & Hasegawa (2008) I-D curves are regional empirical screening envelopes based on gridded Open-Meteo precipitation (~10-25 km), which can miss localized cloudburst cells.

edges.trigger_rule: dated_landslides_14d >= 1 (feature_type in {landslide_event, coseismic_failure}) coinciding with heavy rainfall or elevated river discharge
edges.uncertainty_note: Only dated confirmed/reported landslide events enter this rule; undated OSM scars are strictly excluded. Landslide-dam formation depends on valley constriction and material volume.

edges.trigger_rule: active debris_dam_valley_flood overlapping districts with mapped corridor bridges or moderate/high road-cut isolation screening risk
edges.uncertainty_note: Bridge and settlement counts derive from 1 km corridor OSM screening (lower bound); actual road closure requires Department of Roads / NDRRMA field confirmation.

edges.trigger_rule: observed earthquake M >= 4.5 (<=30 d, USGS or BIPAD NSC) within 100 km of high/very-high/priority glacial lakes or steep high-isolation basins
edges.uncertainty_note: 100 km epicentral proximity is a screening radius, not a site-specific ground-motion or PGA threshold; consult USGS ShakeMap, Nowicki Jessee (2018) ground-failure products, and DMG/NEMRC.

edges.trigger_rule: active coseismic slope/moraine screening overlapping routed GLOF/valley corridors with moderate or high bridge-cut isolation risk
edges.uncertainty_note: Corridor access disruption reflects static OSM bridge/settlement screening along steep valley roads; actual seismic road damage requires ground or SAR verification.

edges.trigger_rule: routed glacial lakes with Rounce hazard in {high, very high} or PFV >= 10 Mm3 or documented ice-cored moraine intersecting corridor bridges or hydropower
edges.uncertainty_note: Static structural screening pathway (1 km search corridor, NOT a 2D hydrodynamic inundation boundary); expresses standing exposure rather than imminent outburst probability.

edges.trigger_rule: warm_rain_on_ice == True on priority lakes OR M >= 4.5 earthquake within 100 km of priority/ice-cored lakes OR official BIPAD GLOF alert (hazard=26)
edges.uncertainty_note: Warm rain-on-ice (liquid_rain_12d >= 10 mm and freezing_margin >= 300 m) and 100 km seismic proximity are environmental stress indicators, not deterministic breach forecasts.

edges.trigger_rule: corridor bridges_at_corridor_crossing > 0 AND upstream_settlements_potentially_isolated > 0 along susceptible GLOF corridors
edges.uncertainty_note: Isolation counts reflect OSM-mapped settlements and hospitals using geodesic distance and valley bridge crossings; actual emergency access also depends on airlift/alternative tracks.
